name: Lim Seng
bio: Lim Seng owns the Kim Hong and its declared porcelain and silk. He wants the honest part of the cargo and his house's name kept separate from his factor's dealings.
notes: fact: Junks from Guangdong traded at Melaka, and Guangdong and Fujian merchants carried Chinese silk and ceramics (docs/research/ships-weights-currency.md, Chinese and Ryukyuan Junks; docs/research/commodities.md, Silk and Porcelain)

gameplay: The Kim Hong is a Guangzhou junk with porcelain bowls and raw silk. Lim Seng disclaims ownership of the nutmeg, not the whole cargo (data/inspections/case_001.json; data/events/ev_kim_hong_owner_plea.json)

gameplay: If the clean lots are kept distinct in a note to the temenggung, Lim Seng supplies a useful lead about Upeh; if the tea gift becomes the story, his fellow captains seek separate assurances before trading (data/events/ev_kim_hong_owner_plea.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §09)
